lines.en: You are not allowed to park here unless you have a special permit.
Employees must wear their badges at all times while they are in the building.
You do not have to come to the office on Fridays; working from home is allowed.
Smoking is forbidden in all public places in the city center.
Are we supposed to finish the report today, or can we hand it in tomorrow?
Visitors are required to sign in at the reception desk before entering.
You had better not use your phone during the exam, or you will be disqualified.
Children under twelve are not permitted to enter without an adult.
We were not allowed to take photos inside the museum, so we bought postcards instead.
The rules were made to protect everyone, even if they sometimes feel strict.
